_journals_help: Papers are featured only if they appear in one of these journals. Key = journal name as OpenAlex spells it (lowercase is fine). 'name' = how the site shows it, 'if' = impact factor shown on the site. To feature a new journal, add a line here.

journal of engineering and technology ma.name: Journal of Engineering and Technology Management

international journal of artificial inte.name: International Journal on Artificial Intelligence Tools

international journal on artificial inte.name: International Journal on Artificial Intelligence Tools

international journal of computational i.name: International Journal of Computational Intelligence Systems

_metrics_help: Google Scholar numbers. The update tries to refresh them from your Scholar profile; if Google blocks it, these values stay as they are. You can also edit them by hand.
_goatcounter_help: Visitor stats: after creating a free GoatCounter account, put its code here (for maikelleon.goatcounter.com, the code is maikelleon). Leave empty for no analytics.
_students_help: Papers you co-authored with these students are listed under Teaching > Undergraduate research, newest first. Add a student's name as it appears on the paper. Badges and code links go in student_extras, keyed by DOI.
_paper_links_help: Extra links shown beside a paper in the publication lists, keyed by DOI. The icon can be globe, play, doc, or download.
_reviews_exclude_help: Journals never to list under Journals reviewed for, even if they appear in the peer-review section of your ORCID record.
